photos.title: Dance Spirit
photos.description: My vision and concept of dance photography is to make sure that the moment you are living remains without being fixed in time, by using long exposures. I seek the release of the frozen forms of conventional photography, melting them into blurs that remind us of brushstrokes on a canvas.

Kambala
photos.description: Kambala is an annual buffalo race held in the southwestern Indian state of Karnataka. Traditionally, it is sponsored by local Tuluva landlords and households in the coastal districts of Dakshina Kannada and Udupi of Karnataka and Kasaragod of Kerala, a region collectively known as Tulu Nadu.

photos.title: Crossing the river
photos.description: When the air temperature rises above 30 °C, as the sweat glids of the water buffaloes are 10% less than that of the cattle, they cannot assign enough body temperature through sweat. This causes their metabolism to deteriorate. To prevent this negativeness and cool down, they need to enter the water several times a day. As they return from the area where they graze all day, they cool off by entering the water channels around a few times. They need to go through a final pond to clean up and cool off again before returning home.
